unittest.replacements: three real HTTP tests for 64KiB recovery, header-only hard refusal, malformed/incomplete requests

resource_policy.above_recovery_window: 413 + Connection: close before body read; no original input is claimed recovered
resource_policy.within_recovery_window: standard parse_qs; complete input returned; CSRF / missing id / database failure semantics retained; body >8192 never saves

frontend: No new JavaScript: existing maxlength=200 constrains the normal edit UI; 1000-character invalid HTTP input fits the bounded recovery window. Hard-refusal page explicitly says no body was received and no edit was saved, with the same prefix-aware edit link. It does not claim arbitrary client input was preserved.
scope: Only independent candidate and independent_bounded_* evidence changed; no platform or preview service touched; disposable test databases only.
known_existing_warning: Python 3.14 reports ResourceWarning from original sqlite3 connection context-manager use. Full unfiltered warning log is retained. This bounded-body candidate does not broaden scope to existing connection lifecycle behavior.
